answer:
The song "Turn Me On" that is performed by Norah Jones (the artist who performs "Feelin' the Same Way") was written by **John D. Loudermilk**. 

Loudermilk originally composed and released the song in 1961 as the B-side to his single "Lonely Island." Norah Jones recorded it as a cover for her debut album "Come Away With Me," releasing it as a single in May 2003.
